column1: # Ezhuthola's own Manglish emoji words (GPL-3.0, part of Ezhuthola).
# Most Manglish already works through the Malayalam CLDR keywords ("chiri" -> ചിരി).
# This list adds everyday spellings and slang Unicode doesn't have,
# plus a few English words where Unicode's order isn't what people expect (love -> ❤️ first).
# Format: word,other spelling<TAB>emojis, best first, separated by spaces.
